name: RHBBANK
recent: RHB Bank 近期获得 RAM Ratings 将其及子公司评级上调至 AAA/Stable。同时，EPF 在 10 月至 11 月间持续申报股权变动，董事会也有成员变动。最新财报显示 2026 年第二季度净利环比下降 5.8%，但同比微增 0.5%。
notable: RAM Ratings 将 RHB Bank 及两家子公司的评级上调至 AAA/Stable。
EPF 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报其作为大股东的股权变动。
CIK LIM YING LING JUDY 出现董事会成员变动。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 MYR 2,155.73 million，环比下降 1.6%，同比微降 0.1%；净利为 MYR 807.15 million，环比下降 5.8%，同比上升 0.5%；净利率为 37.4%，低于上一季度的 39.1%。

recent_en: RHB Bank was recently upgraded to AAA/Stable by RAM Ratings, covering the bank and its subsidiaries. Meanwhile, EPF continued to file changes in its substantial shareholder interest from October to November, and there was a boardroom change. The latest quarterly results showed net income down 5.8% QoQ but up 0.5% YoY.
notable_en: RAM Ratings upgraded RHB Bank and two subsidiaries to AAA/Stable.
EPF filed multiple changes in its substantial shareholder interest between October and November 2026.
There was a boardroom change involving CIK LIM YING LING JUDY.
earnings_en: 2Q2026 revenue was MYR 2,155.73 million, down 1.6% QoQ and 0.1% YoY; net income was MYR 807.15 million, down 5.8% QoQ but up 0.5% YoY; net margin was 37.4%, lower than 39.1% in the previous quarter.
